message.content: {"caption":"Color-coded vertical bar chart comparing SpreadsheetBench verification pass rates across reference skills, concurrent systems, and Trace2Skill variants.","description":"The chart plots SpreadsheetBench-Vrf (%) on a vertical axis from 0 to 80, with ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. The horizontal axis has eight categories. Gray bars denote Reference skills: No Skill is 27.7 and Human-Written is 48.3. Blue bars denote Concurrent systems: XSkill is 23, SkillGen is 27.5, EvoSkill (Claude Code) is 33.5, and EvoSkill (React) is 59.5. Green bars denote Trace2Skill (ours): +Error is 65.8 and +Combined is 69.8. A dashed horizontal line marks the Human-Written reference level of 48.3.
